robocaddy.storyTitle: Golf has always been a game of movement.
storyParagraphs: For generations, golfers walked the fairways, experiencing the course one step at a time. Then golf carts made the game more accessible and convenient.
But golfers have always had to choose: to walk, to ride, or to compromise. We created ROBOCADDY to give golfers a better choice. Walk, ride, or do both, and make golf more enjoyable.
robocaddy.closing: Modern golf is about to move forward.

faq.headline: A few things you may be wondering.
faq.intro: Answers about single-rider electric golf carts, test rides, pricing and course programs.

items.q: What is an INNO-F1 single-rider golf cart?
items.a: INNO-F1 is an electric golf cart built for one driver. Original and Light give golfers their own seat and space for a golf bag, so each player can drive to their own ball. Marshal provides rear utility storage for course teams. INNOXONE creates personal golf mobility for individual golfers, clubs, public courses and resorts.

items.q: Which INNO-F1 is right for me?
items.a: Original is designed for personal golf mobility. Light offers a simplified single-rider configuration. Marshal focuses on course operations and player assistance, with rear utility storage. Contact us to discuss the configurations currently available.

items.q: Can I try an INNO-F1 before deciding?
items.a: Contact us to arrange a test ride or a visit to the INNOXONE Golf Gallery. Tell us where you are based and which model interests you so we can confirm the available options.

items.q: Can my course introduce single-rider golf?
items.a: Yes, you can speak with INNOXONE about demonstrations, premium rental options, member programs and mobility for course teams. Share your course location and goals. Program scope, availability and any operational benefits should be evaluated for your course.

ROBOCADDY is INNOXONE’s Walk & Ride Golf mobility family, created to give golfers the choice to walk, ride or do both. The 2027 collection is coming soon at the Orlando PGA Show in January 2027. Contact our team for details about the reveal and future availability.

items.q: How do I confirm price, delivery and availability?
items.a: Contact INNOXONE with your preferred model, quantity and delivery location. Our team can discuss the appropriate configuration and confirm current pricing, shipping arrangements and timing before you make a purchase.

items.q: What are CONNECT and Intelligent Golf Operations?
items.a: INNOXONE CONNECT is our vision for linking golfers, intelligent vehicles and course operators. Intelligent Golf Operations is the broader direction combining mobility products, services and connected operations. Ask our team about development, course collaboration and future availability.

items.q: Where is the INNOXONE Golf Gallery?
items.a: Visit 31896 Plaza Dr, Suite D2, San Juan Capistrano, CA 92675. Call or text 949-384-9663 before your visit to confirm hours, demonstrations and the models on display.

items.q: What can I do at XONE Golf Club?
items.a: XONE Golf Club brings indoor golf into the INNOXONE Gallery with four TrackMan simulator bays. Visit xonegolf.com for bookings, instruction, current programs and opening hours.

items.q: How do I get help with an INNO-F1 I already own?
items.a: Visit our Support page or email info@innoxone.com with your model and a description of what you need. The team can direct your product, service and warranty questions.

items.q: Where can I learn more about INNO-F2?
items.a: Explore the INNO-F2 preview on this page, then contact INNOXONE to discuss specifications, available configurations and timing. Our team can help you understand the options for your own golf or your course.

harold.headline: Better golf starts with how you move.
harold.name: Meet Harold.
paragraphs: Harold discovered INNO-F1 on YouTube, then flew from Arizona to California for a test ride. He chose a personal ride of his own.
On the course, that choice meant something simple: staying with his own ball, keeping his rhythm and giving his next shot his full attention.
That is why INNOXONE exists: to design personal golf mobility around the way people play, and give more golfers the freedom Harold found.
harold.quote: I can go right to my ball.

headline: Two golfers.

Why one ride?
origin.intro: A different question. A different kind of golf cart.
origin.text: Two golfers can share a round without taking the same route. Young Kim saw a chance to design an electric golf cart around one player, one golf bag and the next shot.
origin.filmTitle: Meet the designer. Hear the idea.
origin.name: Young Kim
origin.role: Founder of INNOXONE · Designer of INNO-F1

chapters.title: Start with your own game.
chapters.text: Golfers hit different shots and head in different directions. A cart built for one lets you go straight to your own ball, without taking a shared cart to another player’s shot first.

chapters.title: Put the essentials around you.
chapters.text: INNO-F1 brings together a single seat, steering and controls within reach, and space for your golf bag. You drive the cart. Your clubs come with you.

chapters.title: Keep the round your own.
chapters.text: Choose where to stop, get ready for your next shot and enjoy your own space. You still share the round with your group, with the freedom to move independently.

origin.closing: Your own seat. Your own clubs. Your own way to the next shot.
origin.label: The story of INNO-F1
origin.designerTitle: A designer’s eye. A golfer’s freedom.
origin.designerText: In his PGA Show interview, Young Kim connects his experience designing everyday products with his lifelong interest in cars. For INNO-F1, he brought that thinking to a simple question: why should a golf cart always be built for two?

photo.alt: Red INNO-F1 single-rider electric golf cart with a golf bag outside a California clubhouse.
title: From a new idea
to your next round.
photo.text: That is the idea behind INNO-F1: a personal electric golf cart that lets you follow your own ball. Sit in it, drive it and see how it fits the way you play.
